purpose: Exhaustively reconcile what System Master has completed, what remains owed, where all historical/current work belongs, and which expected capabilities still require current evidence. This audit is checkpointed so interruption never requires replaying the whole repository or chat history.
watermark_rule: Audit evidence and classifications against these heads. Do not restart if live refs advance. At finalization compare live refs with this watermark and reconcile only the delta.
phase_rules: Complete and commit one phase before beginning the next.
Never mark completion from a chat claim alone; bind to a repository record, exact receipt/artifact/commit or explicit bounded control standing.
Never move exact-SHA qualification authority when reallocating ownership taxonomy.
Preserve historical/stale records; classify/supersede rather than delete evidence.
Anything without an owner becomes UNALLOCATED and cannot execute, schedule or promote until assigned.
Anything with ambiguous evidence becomes EVIDENCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than guessed complete or incomplete.

phases.name: Core/Foundation & Spine completion census
phases.scope: Foundation/UAF/SMR/continuity/assurance/data/platform/chat/ops/UX/KEEL/interop closures and exact evidence; separate portable, hosted, A-01, native and production standings.

phases.name: Learning completion and obligation census
phases.scope: Learning impl/qual/pilot/request/repair lineages, frozen authority, machine qualification, human-only boundaries, current technical successor selection.
phases.global_admission_blocker: P1 remains PENDING under the central phase-sequencing rule. Do not replay the completed Learning owner-lane forensic work when P2 becomes globally admissible; validate only any live delta after the sealed P2 result.

phases.name: Book completion and obligation census
phases.scope: Book parent foundations, lifecycle/editorial/research/publication/export/versioning/author decision state; distinguish Book parent work from Prose child work.

phases.name: Prose completion and obligation census
phases.scope: Book Evaluator, evaluator training, prose diagnostics/training/calibration/revision/preservation lanes, private/human/author boundaries and exact evidence.

phases.name: Shared infrastructure and A-01 census
phases.scope: A-01 control plane, tickets, receipts, runner, Second Shift, closed-loop repair, historical one-shot transports and other non-system infrastructure.

phases.name: Expected product-module allocation census
phases.scope: Reconcile the August 31 product-module inventory and later requirements to current owners: implemented/partial/planned/headless/deferred/excluded/reconciliation-required. Historical counts are not current proof.

phases.name: Orphan/unallocated branch-workstream census
phases.scope: Branch families, workstream IDs, issues, qualification lanes and control records not yet mapped; classify historical-only, superseded, active-owned or UNALLOCATED.

phases.name: Ledger reconciliation
phases.scope: Update COMPLETION-LEDGER, WORK-OBLIGATION-REGISTRY, EXPECTATION-REGISTRY and REALLOCATION-LEDGER so every discovered item has one truthful durable disposition.

phases.name: Live delta, stale-state cleanup and seal
phases.scope: Compare live control heads/main with watermark; reconcile only post-watermark changes; clean stale live tickets/delegations/control pointers without deleting history; seal successor state baseline and one central next objective.

resume_rule: A replacement chat/task reads this checkpoint and starts at the first phase whose status is not COMPLETE. It does not replay completed phases unless evidence specifically invalidates them. A phase with owner_lane_result COMPLETE__SEALED_RESULT_AVAILABLE is not replayed when its turn becomes globally admissible; reconcile only the live delta and admit the sealed result.
final_exit_condition: Every evidence-backed completion and every known open obligation is owned and durable; every current control can explain its predecessor chain; expected capabilities have current dispositions; active Second Shift lists contain only live revalidated delegations; no known active work depends on chat memory alone.
